**Coverage for gradual escape of liquid:**
Both the AAMI Building and Contents PDS state that gradual loss or damage caused by liquid escaping from specified sources (drains, pipes, water mains, fixed tanks, pools/spas, baths, sinks, toilets, basins, tap spindles, fixed heating/cooling systems, refrigerators, freezers, dishwashers, washing machines, waterbeds, or aquariums) **is covered**, but only when "the loss or damage, that was occurring, wasn't easily visible to a reasonable person in the circumstances" [AAMI Building PDS, page 46; AAMI Contents PDS, page 51].

**Key exclusion — visibility test:**
This implies that if the gradual damage *was* easily visible to a reasonable person as it was occurring, it would **not** be covered under this insured event, though the excerpts do not spell out this exclusion in explicit exclusionary language — it is stated as a condition of the "gradual loss or damage" cover itself.

I do not have excerpts that contain a standalone "long-term water leak exclusion" clause. The only relevant provision found is the visibility condition attached to the gradual liquid escape cover noted above [AAMI Building PDS, page 46; AAMI Contents PDS, page 51].
